executivo.nota: Leis: as 75 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 2/4/2026 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). O SAPL não separa as poucas leis que a própria Câmara promulga (quando derruba um veto ou quando o prefeito não assina no prazo), então elas também entram. Vetos: os projetos que, pelo andamento registrado no SAPL, receberam veto total ou parcial a partir de 2/4/2026.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 75 ordinary and complementary laws dated from April 2, 2026 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). SAPL does not separate the few laws the Council promulgates itself (when it overrides a veto or when the mayor does not sign in time), so they are included too. Vetoes: the bills that, according to the progress recorded in SAPL, were vetoed in whole or in part from April 2, 2026 on.
executivo.notaLeis: Leis: as 75 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 2/4/2026 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). executivo.notaLeis_en: Laws: the 75 ordinary and complementary laws dated from April 2, 2026 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). SAPL does not separate the few laws the Council promulgates itself (when it overrides a veto or when the mayor does not sign in time), so they are included too.
